description: This file provides two utility functions for development testing related to project cost API endpoints. The functions allow quick invocation of project cost data fetches with hardcoded or sample project IDs, mainly for debugging or testing purposes.

methods.name: devTryProjectCost(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches project cost for a given project ID, defaulting to '21566' if no ID is provided, and logs the result for development purposes.

methods.name: devTrySampleProjectCosts()
methods.description: Fetches project costs for a set of sample project IDs ('21566' and '20684') and logs the results in a table format.
